选择一种颜色并获得对应效果。

Enchanting Rhapsody.name: 魅惑狂想曲 Enchanting Rhapsody
Enchanting Rhapsody.description:
You use your music to influence your foes to do as you wish. Enemy creatures in the initial area or that end their turn in the area must make a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to their saves against mental effects until they leave the area and for 1 round after. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.xw2Z41yDSg7JW4hb]{效果：魅惑狂想曲}

Failure As success, except the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂} until they leave the area and for 1 round after and the status penalty increases to –2.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target must spend the first action on each of its turns to [[/act perform variant=dance]] by dancing to the music for as long as it is fascinated.

Escape Time's Shackles.name: 逃离时之桎梏 Escape Time's Shackles
Escape Time's Shackles.description: You speed up your personal time bubble, allowing time to pass over you more quickly. Your body moves forward in time, causing 1 minute of time to effectively pass over for you. Any effects or conditions with a duration are immediately reduced by 1 minute. Roll saving throws, flat checks, damage, and any other rolls for those effects normally as if the time had passed. If your cursebound value is 2, you cause 1 hour of time to pass, and if your cursebound value is 3 you cause 1 day of time to pass. Escape Time's Shackles does not remove the cursebound condition or allow you to rest or make your daily preparations again.

Wishful Thinking.name: 如愿之思 Wishful Thinking
Wishful Thinking.description:
你以让难以置信成为可能来协助盟友。在你30尺内选择一名盟友，影响其心智使其相信自己能做不可能之事——选定下列效果之一为其授予梦境之特殊能力。法术效果持续至效果结束，但你须于每回合结束时以@Check[deception|against:will|options:wishful-thinking-deception]检定对抗目标的意志DC，否则法术立即结束。如你的法术攻击调整值更高，可使用其代替欺诈调整值。

  • 目标对攻击检定与豁免获得+1状态加值。

  • 目标对你所选特定技能的检定获得+2状态加值。

  • 目标获得30尺攀爬速度与30尺范围之不精确嗅觉。

  • 目标获得30尺游泳速度与水下呼吸能力。

提升（6阶） 状态加值增加1，且可选择给目标30尺飞行速度作为另一选项。

提升（9阶） 可选择两项效果代替一项。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.k7Hqre7oOIR6gInb]{效果：一厢情愿}

Unknowable Icon.name: 不可知图腾 Unknowable Icon
Unknowable Icon.description:
Domain glyph (apocryphal)

You transcribe ancient and forgotten knowledge into a single rune that overwhelms and shatters the mind. You place a rune on a 5-foot square of a flat surface within your reach which remains dormant until a living creature other than you comes within 10 feet of it. After a creature comes within 10 feet, the rune becomes active after 1 round has passed and all creatures in a 10-foot emanation of the rune must attempt a basic Will Save or take 1d12 mental and 1d4 spirit damage. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 mental and 1d4 spirit.

Feel My Pain.name: 感我之痛 Feel My Pain
Feel My Pain.description:
Trigger You take persistent damage.

You share your pain when it is dealt to you. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC, taking the same persistent damage you take if it fails its save.

Well of Joy.name: 欢欣之井 Well of Joy
Well of Joy.description:
You fill an ally with hope for the future, granting them a renewed sense of vigor and joy. Choose a creature within 30 feet. The chosen creature gains 4 temporary Hit Points for 1 minute. If you’re cursebound 1 when you use Well of Joy, the creature gains 8 temporary Hit Points, if you’re cursebound 2 they gain 16 temporary Hit Points, and if you’re cursebound 3 they gain 24 temporary Hit Points. In addition, they are immune to fear effects while they have temporary Hit Points. If the creature has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧} condition it is suspended until the they no longer have temporary Hit Points, which returns with the same value as when it was suspended.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.2G2KHpPCP3VZggC9]{效果：欢乐之井}

Curse of the Everpresent Sonata.name: 永驻奏鸣之咒 Curse of the Everpresent Sonata
Curse of the Everpresent Sonata.description:
无论怎样努力，你都无法逃脱跟随你的歌；压力之时它愈发响亮，最终成为你能听见的一切。当你移动、欢笑或言语时，有时可听见微弱的乐器伴奏，你所做的一切都几乎具有节奏。咒缚时，乐声膨胀，成为你所能听见的一切。

咒缚1 歌声开始演奏，吸引其他声音如管弦乐之乐器。你获得音波弱点2，具听觉特征且以你为目标之敌对效果触发此弱点。

咒缚2 乐声压倒你其他感官。你在察觉检定与对抗听觉效果之豁免上承受–2状态减值。

咒缚3 你的音波弱点等于5+你的等级。

咒缚4 歌声吞噬一切。当你尝试施放无听觉或音波特征之法术时，你须以@Check[flat|dc:10]检定，否则失去该法术。

Vision of the Weeping Heart.name: 泣心之幻象 Vision of the Weeping Heart
Vision of the Weeping Heart.description:
你的幻象向你展示一场你尚未解读的悲剧，但你或许有力量去修复它。寒冰先知或许看见暴雪中的角猿，发现自己为之哭泣；森林先知或许看见一名公主胸口被一巨大鬼火拔出之剑。

替代领域 安息

替代授予法术 1阶：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{慰藉}

授予技能 外交

幻象态 你必须治愈破碎者之伤——即使他们不情愿。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tuZnRWHixLArvaIf]{救赎一瞥}圣骑士反应，但授予盟友的抗性减2。如超过1轮未使用救赎一瞥，咒缚值+1（至最大值）。出于救赎一瞥之考量，你的圣骑士光环范围为5尺加5尺×咒缚值。6级时，救赎一瞥授予完整抗性。

觉醒态 你可选择使因救赎一瞥而拒绝救赎之敌人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞}（而非力竭2级），持续相同时间。如咒缚值为3，敌人若拒绝则承受@Damage[(@actor.abilities.cha.mod)[spirit,persistent]]{等于你魅力调整值}的灵魂持续伤害。如咒缚值为4，每回合获得仅可用于救赎一瞥的额外反应。

Foreseen Retaliation.name: 预见反击 Foreseen Retaliation
Foreseen Retaliation.description:
Your foresight not only protects your ally, but allows them to retaliate in kind. When you use Reveal the Mystery while benefiting from The Mystery Grows, you grant your ally the same status bonus to damage to its Strikes against the target of your Curio’s Foresight.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.z1p6jvxvqmks2kU9]{效果：先知反击}

Curio's Form.name: 奇物形态 Curio's Form
Curio's Form.description: 当你融入战斗形态时，你的奇物仍可使用。当你进入战斗形态时，你保留使用依赖于奇物效果（如奇物预见）的能力。处于战斗形态时，你按奇物获得以下效果。

Purge Sickness.name: 净化病恙 Purge Sickness
Purge Sickness.description:
Requirements You have the sickened condition.

Your body is so accustomed to being ravaged by your curse that other such consequences are easily dismissed. You retch to reduce your sickened condition, gaining your cursebound value as a status bonus to your check to remove the condition. If you’re cursebound 2 when you use Purge Sickness, you treat your degree of success as one step better.

Tectonic Fracture.name: 构造断裂 Tectonic Fracture
Tectonic Fracture.description:
With a long stare, you see where the world is weakest and shatter it. You stomp on the ground creating difficult terrain in a @Template[cone|distance:15] and creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:spell] save. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Tectonic Fracture, the area is a @Template[cone|distance:30] and if you are cursebound 3, it is instead a @Template[cone|distance:45].

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} until the beginning of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}.

Atavistic Landslide.name: 返祖崩塌 Atavistic Landslide
Atavistic Landslide.description: All things crumble with time, even ancient mountains, and you shall endure even this. At the end of each turn for 1 minute, you create a landslide of rubble and boulders that travels in a @Template[line|distance:35], except the line passes through you at the center point with an equal line on each side of you. The landslide deals @Damage[1d10[bludgeoning]|basic] damage to all creatures in the area with a @Check[reflex|basic|agaist:spell] save and creatures that critically fail their save are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}. You can't Dismiss this landslide, but you can suppress the effect for 1 round with a Sustain action. The landslide is suppressed if you fall unconscious. If you become cursebound 3 or 4 at any point during Atavistic Landslide's duration, the line increases to a @Template[line|distance:55] and the damage increases to @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]|basic].

Glimpse Future.name: 瞥见未来 Glimpse Future
Glimpse Future.description:
Though your eyes can't let you see everything that is around you, they show you images of what is to come. You [[/act recall-knowledge statistic=spell options=glimpse-future]] on a single creature within 30 feet of you using your spell attack modifier for your check against a standard DC for the creature's level, except you treat a critical failure as a failure, and the check loses the secret trait. If your check was successful, you can choose to give the target a –2 status penalty to the next attack roll or save before the beginning of your next turn. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to Glimpse Future for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.13dAWN3gcT3uqOBw]{效果：未来一瞥}

Show to Remember.name: 记忆之示 Show to Remember
Show to Remember.description:
You fill a creature's mind with an overwhelming din that disorients the target. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you, that creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙} for 1 minute. The creature can spend a single action with the concentrate trait to attempt a new Will save against the effect.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢} for as long as they are stupefied.

Dance, Dance.name: 舞，舞，舞 Dance, Dance
Dance, Dance.description:
Your music floods the minds of two adjacent creatures, compelling them to move in time. Choose two creatures within 30 feet of you that are adjacent to each other. Both creatures must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save, but both creatures use the better result between them when determining the result of the effect. If you choose a willing ally as one of the targets, they can choose to get a result of a failure without rolling, but their movement triggers reactions to creatures other than the targets of this effect normally.

Critical Success The creatures do not move and a willing ally is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地} from the shuffle.

Success Both creatures sway in a dance, moving 5 feet in a direction of your choice, remaining adjacent to one another. This is forced movement.

Failure As success, except both creatures move up to 10 feet, remaining adjacent to one another for the entirety of the movement.

Prism of Power.name: 力之棱镜 Prism of Power
Prism of Power.description:
You conjure an intangible magical prism that interacts with magic as if it were light. You create a prism that occupies a @Template[square|distance:5] within range. When you create the prism, select one of the following options.

  • Diffract Magic enters the prism and is split into a spectrum. If a line spell enters the area of the prism, the area changes from a line to a cone and its size is equal to half the remaining feet the line could travel before it entered the prism in the same direction the line could travel (minimum 5 feet).

  • Refract Magic entering the prism can change directions, even around corners. If a spell attack targets the prism or a line spell passes through its space, and doing so does not require all of the spell’s range, it can alter directions. Determine your spell's line of effect and line of sight from the prism, as well as whether creatures have cover against the spell. The spell can exceed its normal range as measured from you, as long as it's within its normal range from the prism.

  • Scatter Magic is dispersed and reflected all around the prism. You can target 2 creatures with a spell attack by targeting the prism, targeting up to 2 creatures within 5 feet of the prism. For the purposes of a spell attack roll, you roll your spell attack roll once and compare the result against the AC of both creatures.

Accursed Flame Form.name: 咒缚火焰形态 Accursed Flame Form
Accursed Flame Form.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

You let sacred fire consume you, transforming you into a burning monster. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{元素形态} heightened to the highest rank spell you can cast. You must choose an elemental form with the fire trait.

Special If you have access to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.bK4rp20XuJRWGsEv]{元素变形} (Magic+), you can choose to gain the effects of elemental shift heightened to the highest rank spell you can cast and you must select the fire elemental aspect.

Reverse Movement.name: 逆转移动 Reverse Movement
Reverse Movement.description:
You refract time in order to cover a great distance and then return to where you started. You mark your current location with a figment of your form and leave translucent images of yourself when you move for a number of rounds equal to 1 plus your cursebound value ([[/r (1+ @actor.conditions.cursebound.value )#rounds]]), tracing back to the space you first used this action. During this time, you gain access to the Reversal Move free action. After you use Reversal Move, you end this effect.

Reversal Move f (divine, oracle, teleportation)

Effect You swap places with your shadow in a burst of darkness. You create magical darkness that lasts until the end of your next turn in a 15-foot emanation around the position of your shadowy duplicate and yourself. You can choose to change positions with your shadow when you use this action, and if you do, the spell gains the teleportation trait.

Spirit Steps.name: 精魂之步 Spirit Steps
Spirit Steps.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

Your body fades into ectoplasm, leaving you a translucent figure with a visible skeleton and chains tying you to the earth. You gain the incorporeal trait for 1 minute and a resistance to all damage (except spirit, vitality, or ghost touch) equal to twice your cursebound value, but you cannot pass through solid objects or walls. If your cursebound value is 3 when you use Spirit Steps, you can pass through solid objects, including walls while incorporeal. When inside an object, you can’t perceive, attack, or interact with anything outside the object, and if you start your turn in an object, you’re @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢} until the end of your turn. You and corporeal creatures can pass through on another, but neither of you can end your movement in the other’s space. If you are in the area of a solid object or wall when this effect ends, you take @Damage[(@actor.level)[spirit]]{spirit damage equal to your level} as you are shunted to the nearest space you could occupy.

Preparatory Cremation.name: 火化预备 Preparatory Cremation
Preparatory Cremation.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet of you takes fire damage.

You cause a burned creature to become ash-like, making them brittle and weak. The creature gains a weakness to physical damage equal to twice your cursebound value until the end of your next turn. Attacks that deal physical damage gain the death trait against the target while they have this weakness, their body turning into dust and ash if killed in this way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.Qkrxlll3LxBXBXup]{效果：预备焚化}

Matchmaker.name: 媒人 Matchmaker
Matchmaker.description:
Domain passion (apocryphal)

You gaze into the heart of the yearning, and find what will help their hearts settle. When you cast this spell, you Recall Knowledge with a special skill called Love Lore, in which you become trained for the duration. You find out if the target of your Recall Knowledge is the object of desire or yearns for another creature or object. You can also cast this spell to Make a [[/act request skill=love-lore]] to convince creatures to go on romantic excursions with others. If the target of the spell would not usually be willing to do so, the spell automatically fails.

Heightened (2nd) You become an expert in Love Lore for the duration.

Heightened (4th) You become a master in Love Lore for the duration.

Heightened (8th) You become legendary in Love Lore for the duration

Chosen Disciples.name: 天选门徒 Chosen Disciples
Chosen Disciples.description: You have guided your followers to learn great secrets of your mystery. During your daily preparations, you can choose to grant one of your followers a 1st-rank divine spell in your oracle spell repertoire, gaining the ability to Cast the Spell once per day. At least 10th level, you can choose to grant one 2nd-rank spell in your oracle spell repertoire in addition to the 1st-rank divine spell, and if you are at least 12th level, you can choose to grant one 3rd-rank spell in your oracle spell repertoire in addition to the 1st-rank and 2nd-rank divine innate spell. If you have multiple followers, you can divide these spells among them.

Orb of Brilliance.name: 辉煌之球 Orb of Brilliance
Orb of Brilliance.description:
The enemy of the dark is the light, and it flees with great speed in its presence. You send out a burst of light in a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 500 feet. The burst generates bright light in the area and dim light 20 feet out from the area for up to 1 minute. Mist, fog, or other similar concealment does not grant the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽} condition to creatures in the area unless the concealment would be the result of an effect that cannot be used to Hide (such as blur). The orb can be seen from great distances and creatures that end their turn within the area take a status penalty to Perception checks equal to your cursebound value.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.4O0gLYll9fdNQkCa]{效果：辉煌法球}

Unmitigated Gaze of the Curio.name: 奇物无遮凝视 Unmitigated Gaze of the Curio
Unmitigated Gaze of the Curio.description: Your foresight has become so intense, the target of your focus cannot escape you. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{真知视} on creatures that you have a +2 status bonus to AC and saves against from Curio’s Foresight.

Seismic Shift.name: 地震位移 Seismic Shift
Seismic Shift.description:
You bring the rocky mountain beneath your feet to propel you forward. You move up to 30 feet, the earth moving beneath your feet as it propels you to your destination, avoiding difficult terrain. You must end your movement in an unoccupied space where you have solid footing. Every square you pass through becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. This movement isn't a Stride, but you measure the distance in a similar way, and it still triggers reactions caused by movement. You can't transport anyone else with you.

Heightened (+1) Increase the distance you move by 5 feet.

Vision of the Glorious Victory.name: 辉煌胜利之幻象 Vision of the Glorious Victory
Vision of the Glorious Victory.description:
在你的幻象中，你被展示了围绕你秘奥的高潮冲突。骨骸先知或许看见一场与双头三臂怪物的战斗，而歌之先知或许在地狱骑士军团面前听见一个新国度的圣歌。

替代领域 狂热

替代授予法术 2阶：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mrDi3v933gsmnw25]{心灵操作}

授予技能 运动

幻象态 你以战斗胜利寻求幻象的答案。你在运动检定上获得状态加值，等于咒缚值一半（最低1）。遭遇战首回合后，若结束某回合时未使用运动动作或咒缚动作，咒缚值+1（至最大值）。

觉醒态 觉醒期间，你获得一项你满足前提条件的运动技能专长之效果。如咒缚值为3，运动检定状态加值等于完整咒缚值。如咒缚值为4，可选择获得4阶@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{巨化术}之效果。

Amplified Accompaniment.name: 扩声伴奏 Amplified Accompaniment
Amplified Accompaniment.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

The music of your curse works to bolster other sounds instead of drowning them out, amplifying it and making creatures more sensitive to sound. For 1 minute, your music plays fervently in an aura in a 30-foot emanation bolstering other sounds and you must include yourself in the area and are included in the effects. Auditory and sonic effects originating within the area increase their range by 30 feet and linguistic effects no longer require that the target share a language while within the area. Creatures within the area gain a weakness to sonic damage equal to your cursebound value or increase their weakness to sonic damage by the same amount. Creatures with immunity to sonic damage are still immune.

Foundry Note Besides the granting of sonic weakness, the rest, you'll have to handle manually (including increasing existing weaknesses). If your cursebound value changes while this aura is active, reapply the aura.

Protection of the Mystery.name: 秘奥护佑 Protection of the Mystery
Protection of the Mystery.description: Your mystery seeks to protect you, even when unprepared. Once per day you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{权变} as an divine innate spell heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up.

The More The Merrier.name: 人多更欢 The More The Merrier
The More The Merrier.description:
What fun one can have when you are surrounded by revelers and debauchery. You create a crowd of illusory creatures of Medium size that fill all unoccupied spaces within the area. The area is difficult terrain and creatures cannot communicate or use auditory or linguistic actions on creatures more than 10 feet away from them while in the area.

In addition, you or your allies can spend a single action to Interact or Perform, causing the crowd in adjacent squares to become greater difficult terrain for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to disbelieve the crowd by spending a single action to Interact or Sense Motive on it. You and your allies ignore difficult and greater difficult terrain caused by the crowd.

Harness the Light.name: 驾驭光辉 Harness the Light
Harness the Light.description:
You draw all the light into a tiny focal point, and disperse it in a small burst. Choose a magical source of light within 30 feet of you, and attempt to @Check[counteract|statistic:spell] it. If you created the magical light, you automatically succeed at your check to counteract. If you successfully counteract the magical light, all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] of the light source must succeed at a @Check[reflex|against:spell] save or they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} for a number of rounds equal to your cursebound value. If the creature critically failed its save against this effect, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} for 1 round. If the target was a creature or shares its space with a creature, you must include the creature in the effect.

If you are cursebound and you target your curse’s light with this effect, you can produce the effect without attempting to counteract your magical light and you treat your degree of success on your save as one step better.

Carnivorous Vegetation.name: 食肉植被 Carnivorous Vegetation
Carnivorous Vegetation.description:
You cause the plants around you to become carnivorous. You cause all plant-life in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] to become carnivorous, harming creatures that end their turn within the area and causing them to take @Damage[(4 + floor(@actor.level / 2 - 6))d6[acid],(4 + floor(@actor.level / 2 - 6))d6[piercing]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|basic|against:spell] save. You and allies within the area get a degree of success one better than rolled on a saving throw.

Particularly large plants within the area when you first use the effect, such as trees, can choose to deal @Damage[(4 + floor(@actor.level / 2 - 6))d6[acid],(4 + floor(@actor.level / 2 - 6))d6[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage} instead of piercing damage and each have their own emanation that produces the same effect. The emanation is a number of feet equal to the size of the plant, such as a 5-foot emanation for a bush that occupies a 5-foot square or a 15-foot emanation for a tree that occupies a 15-foot square. A creature in any of the areas attempts one basic Reflex save against the spell no matter how many overlapping vegetation areas it's caught in and the type of damage dealt is determined by the nearest to the vegetation (subject to GM discretion).

At 14th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the acid damage and piercing damage each increase by 1d6.

Nourishing Rot.name: 滋养之腐 Nourishing Rot
Nourishing Rot.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet gains the sickened condition or becomes diseased.

Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

While sickness plagues your body, the illness of others cleanses you. You regain Hit Points equal to your level plus your cursebound value (@Damage[(@actor.level * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[healing]]).

Garden of Crystals.name: 水晶花园 Garden of Crystals
Garden of Crystals.description:
Domain earth (apocryphal)

You cause crystals to grow from the ground around you. The area becomes difficult terrain, though you can ignore it. Select three @Template[burst|distance:5]s at least partially within the area; enormous clusters of crystals grow here, filled with magic energy. These crystalline structures are 10 feet high and occupy the area, moving any creatures in the area to the nearest adjacent space. When standing adjacent to one of these clusters, creatures' critical hits are empowered, dealing 1d10 force damage.

Heightened (+2) The force damage increases by 1d10.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.NsA3mbbBphp9kx77]{效果：水晶花园}

Hunter's Rush.name: 猎者疾袭 Hunter's Rush
Hunter's Rush.description: You hone in on one enemy, becoming the target of your bestial animosity. Choose an enemy you can see. You Stride twice towards that enemy. If you end your movement within melee reach of the chosen enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Hunter's Rush, increase this to two extra dice, and if you are cursebound 3, increase it to three extra dice.

Curse of Outpouring Life (Team+).name: 倾泻生命之咒（Team+） Curse of Outpouring Life (Team+)
Curse of Outpouring Life (Team+).description: 生命能量自你向外流出，使你与所有生命相连，但你以耗费生命本质换取此连接。你的存在抚慰病者与伤者，使疤痕略显消退，催发植物新生长，并以活力浸染周围。生命力外泄使保持你身体功能愈加困难。恢复你生命值之魔法效果在恢复生命值数量上承受状态减值，等于你等级一半（最低1）×@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{咒缚}值。

Claimed by Ancestors.name: 祖灵召回 Claimed by Ancestors
Claimed by Ancestors.description:
Trigger You or an ally within 60 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points or killed.

Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

Your ancestors surge around an unconscious body, dragging them back to their feet and fighting through them. The triggering creature does not die or gain the dying condition and regains @Damage[(@actor.level * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[healing]] Hit Points equal to your level x your cursebound condition value. However, the sudden surge from your ancestor is difficult to acclimate to, leaving the triggering creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a @Check[will|against:spell] save. If the triggering creature would have been killed, it treats its save against this confusion condition as one step worse.

Familiar Dark.name: 熟稔之暗 Familiar Dark
Familiar Dark.description: The darkness is an old friend, familiar and comforting. You gain greater darkvision for 1 minute and create darkness in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Familiar Dark, the aura is a @Template[emanation|distance:30] and if you are cursebound 3, it is instead a @Template[emanation|distance:120].

Storm Spell.name: 风暴法术 Storm Spell
Storm Spell.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you're in an encounter.

You transform the components of a spell to become powerful blasts of storm magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the air, cold, electricity, or water traits that targets an area, you transform it into a storm spell. The area of the spell becomes difficult terrain and hazardous terrain for a number of rounds equal to your cursebound value. A creature that moves through the area takes damage equal to the spell's rank for every square of that area it moves through. This damage is electricity damage or bludgeoning damage, chosen when you Cast the Spell.

Astral Daydream.name: 星界白日梦 Astral Daydream
Astral Daydream.description: You leverage your connection to the spirit itself, your soul swiftly dancing between worlds, bringing back a gift from the beyond. You become stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn. While stupefied, you gain resistance equal to your cursebound value plus half your level to mental damage and become trained in a skill of your choice. If you were already trained in the chosen skill, you instead gain a +1 status bonus to your next check with the chosen skill for the duration, or a +2 status bonus if you are cursebound 2 when you use Astral Daydream.

Curse of Eternal Reverie.name: 永恒梦呓之咒 Curse of Eternal Reverie
Curse of Eternal Reverie.description: 你对奇思异想之依恋既是恩赐也是常见之苦。你的浅层思想有时闪现成你周围的图像，随诅咒愈强，你愈被仅有你能辨认的奇想分心。你在对抗心灵与视觉效果之豁免与察觉检定上承受状态减值，等于咒缚调整值。

Divine Rampage.name: 神圣狂暴 Divine Rampage
Divine Rampage.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

You become one with the beast, leaving you in an uncontrollable state and a destructive monster. The following effects apply until after you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points and then attempt a @Check[will|against:spell-dc] to end this destructive state. You can choose to forgo this Will save and continue your rampage. If you have not been targeted or included in the area of effect of a hostile action for 1 round, you can attempt a Will save to end this destructive state at the end of your turn.

  • You don’t treat anyone as your ally, except for flanking enemies (though they might still treat you as theirs).

  • You must use all your actions to Strike, cast offensive cantrips, use offensive cursebound actions, or to facilitate attacking, such as drawing a weapon, moving so a target is in reach, and so forth.

  • Your unarmed attacks gain the forceful trait.

  • When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points, you regain Hit Points equal to half your level plus your cursebound value.

Curio's Revelation.name: 奇物启示 Curio's Revelation
Curio's Revelation.description: 你的神器具有揭示秘奥目的之独特方法。你可授予以下效益代替@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.Js9vTrVqDJQeZ2uP]{揭示秘奥}的常规效果。

Body of the Beast.name: 野兽之躯 Body of the Beast
Body of the Beast.description:
Animalistic power surges through you as you channel your divinity. You gain an unarmed attack in the brawling group as the beast within you emerges. The unarmed attack’s Strikes deal additional damage equal to your cursebound condition value. If your cursebound value is 2, you gain a +1 status bonus to Strikes with your unarmed attack while the spell is active, or a +2 if you are cursebound value is 3 or greater.

  • Jaws that deal 1d8 piercing damage

  • Claws that deal 1d4 slashing damage with the agile and finesse traits

  • Horns or antlers that deal 1d6 piercing damage with the shove trait

  • Tentacles or tail that deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage with the reach trait

Heightened (4th) You can select up to 2 unarmed attacks instead of 1 or increase the die size of one of your unarmed attacks by one step.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.alBwXHEEIgpe42Vt]{效果：野兽之躯}

Web of Darkness.name: 黑暗之网 Web of Darkness
Web of Darkness.description:
All the darkness in the area latches on like in webbed strands of shadow, hindering their movements. All enemy creatures in the area must attempt a Reflex save. Creatures can try to Escape the strands of darkness, and it or others can attempt to cut themselves free from the darkness by attacking the strands (the strands have AC [[/r 30+(@item.level - 6)*3]] and [[/r 30+(@item.level - 6)*5]] Hit Points). You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed.

Failure As success, except the creature has a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed and it can’t move more than 30 feet away from the space it was in when you Cast the Spell.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.mOwOxk8Uwyz8hra5]{效果：暗网}

Heightened (+1) The strands’ AC increases by 3, and their Hit Points increase by 5.

Hardened to Suffering.name: 因苦而坚 Hardened to Suffering
Hardened to Suffering.description: Your curse hardens you to outside pain. You gain your choice of a +1 item bonus to AC or increase the item bonus of any armor you are wearing by 1 until the end of your next turn. While you are benefiting from this bonus to AC, you gain resistance to physical damage equal to 2 plus twice your cursebound value.

Vision of the Unraveling Secret.name: 解秘之幻象 Vision of the Unraveling Secret
Vision of the Unraveling Secret.description:
你的幻象向你展示了一件极重要的事——你尚不能理解，但解开其含义将助你改变世界之命运。学识先知或许看见一头大象打开一扇通往不可能图书馆之门，野兽先知或许看见在分形玻璃位面中、比一个人大两倍的蛋壳。

替代领域 知识

替代授予法术 3阶：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{超思}

授予技能 一项具回忆知识动作的技能

幻象态 理解将赋予你力量。遭遇战首回合及每次使用咒缚动作后，你可作为免费动作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}，但回忆知识必须针对当前遭遇中的生物、危害或类似主题。回忆知识与搜索检定获得状态加值等于咒缚值。遭遇战首回合后，若结束某回合时未使用回忆知识、搜索或咒缚动作，咒缚值+1（至最大值）。

觉醒态 你可在每回合结束时作为免费动作进行回忆知识或搜索，且即便回忆知识失败仍可对同一主题再次进行（只要主题在当前遭遇中）。如咒缚值为3，获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{看见隐形}之效果。如咒缚值为4，还获得6阶@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{真知视}之效果。
